proves.claim: with adviceThroughNext true deliverHealthNotices logs every finding but shouts none for a builder-owned finding, while coordinator-owned findings shout as before.

store.logic-board-receipts.builder-advic.why: Without this test, builder advice would keep arriving as separate shouts next to the same advice in next.

proves.claim: with adviceThroughNext false or absent, and for a finding recorded before the setting, the shouts are exactly those of main.

store.logic-board-receipts.builder-advic.why: A replica or an earlier scan must replay with its original shouts, so the setting changes only new scans that froze it.
